finaled: A later permit record indicates completed/finaled ADU work. Confirm the current property configuration before relying on layout assumptions.
active: City records show active ADU-related work. Completion and current occupancy are not established.
issued: A permit was issued, but completion is not established.
expiredOrCancelled: A prior ADU proposal appears expired/cancelled; that does not establish an existing ADU.
unknown: An ADU-related record exists, but its completion status is not clear.
plainClosed: A permit record exists, but the available source does not establish whether the work was completed.
